pins.name: D11
pins.label: D11 (GPIO11)
pins.notes: Dedicated BLTouch/3D-Touch probe control-signal header pin (3D_Touch) - dedicated, not general purpose. Was previously exposed as plain D11 (full digital I/O) due to a static-const alias in pins_arduino.h; corrected here.

pins.name: D12
pins.label: D12 (GPIO12)
pins.notes: Onboard ADXL345 accelerometer dedicated SPI1 bus - MISO (SPI1_MISO / ADXL345 SDO). Was previously exposed as plain D12 (full digital I/O) due to a static-const alias in pins_arduino.h; corrected here - driving this pin generically would corrupt the accelerometer's SPI communication.

pins.name: D13
pins.label: D13 (GPIO13)
pins.notes: Onboard ADXL345 accelerometer dedicated SPI1 bus - CS (SPI1_CS / ADXL345 CS). Same defect fix as GPIO12, same bus.

pins.name: D14
pins.label: D14 (GPIO14)
pins.notes: Onboard ADXL345 accelerometer dedicated SPI1 bus - SCK (SPI1_SCK). Same defect fix as GPIO12, same bus.

pins.name: D15
pins.label: D15 (GPIO15)
pins.notes: Onboard ADXL345 accelerometer dedicated SPI1 bus - MOSI (SPI1_MOSI / ADXL345 SDA/SDI). Same defect fix as GPIO12, same bus.

pins.name: D20
pins.label: GPIO20 (Led Neopixel)
pins.notes: Dedicated WS2812-style addressable RGB LED header (Neopixel, 3-pin 5V/DATA/GND) - confirmed via pins_arduino.h PIN_NEOPIXEL and vendor schematic Header.sch. Was previously exposed as plain D20 (full digital I/O); corrected here to the standard led_neopixel capability set.

pins.name: D21
pins.label: D21 (GPIO21)
pins.notes: Shared Z-probe/BLTouch sensor-signal line (Z+ / PIN_ZPLUS), diode-combined between the PROBE header and the 3D-Touch header - dedicated, not general purpose. Was previously exposed as plain D21 (full digital I/O); corrected here.

pins.name: D24
pins.label: D24 (GPIO24)
pins.notes: X-axis endstop input (IO24) - confirmed as the 'Stepper X' endstop_pin in the vendor's own MKS_THR.cfg Klipper config - dedicated, not general purpose despite the generic '#define PIN_IO24' name. Was previously exposed as plain D24 (full digital I/O); corrected here.

pins.name: D25
pins.label: D25 (GPIO25)
pins.notes: Y-axis endstop input (IO25) - confirmed as the 'Stepper Y' endstop_pin in the vendor's own MKS_THR.cfg Klipper config - dedicated, not general purpose. Was previously exposed as plain D25 (full digital I/O); corrected here.

pins.name: D29/A3
pins.label: D29/A3 (GPIO29)
pins.notes: MT-DET filament-runout/material-detection switch input (IO29) - dedicated, not general purpose despite the generic '#define PIN_IPO29' name. Was previously exposed as plain D29/A3 (full digital I/O + analog input); corrected here.
